verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents a usage-based model ('pay-as-you-go… you only pay for the compute, storage, and bandwidth you actually use'), and a community user independently describes it as usage-based. This implies cost scales with resources rather than team headcount. However, no evidence explicitly states whether seat charges or minimum seat counts exist. missing for 10: explicit statement that there are no per-seat or per-member charges, documentation of any plan minimums or org-level fees, a published pricing page covering team or organization billing.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know whether pricing is per-seat with minimum seat counts that increase cost as my team grows

citations.quote: Fly.io uses pay-as-you-go pricing - you only pay for the compute, storage, and bandwidth you actually use.
you're only billed for the bytes you actually put there
